caption: sky note: "nasa changed your sign, you're an ophiuchus now". needs context. the tropical zodiac follows the seasons, not the constellations.

slides.headline: “nasa added a 13th sign, so your sign changed”
slides.body: nasa didn't add a sign. it explained that the sun crosses 13 constellations, which have drifted from the signs over about 2,000 years. astronomy, not a new zodiac.

slides.headline: the *sky* slowly shifts against the calendar
slides.body: earth's axis wobbles, so the stars behind the sun drift about one degree every 72 years. and yes, the sun does cross ophiuchus each year.

slides.headline: western signs follow the *seasons*, not the stars
slides.body: the tropical zodiac starts aries at the march equinox and cuts the year into 12 equal slices. your sign is your birth season, and that hasn't moved.

slides.headline: you're still a *sagittarius*. you just learned a fun fact
slides.body: astrology is a reading. the astronomy is still true.
